tool_args.rationale: The added open-branch row extends input coverage but all six observations share one short horizon. With mass-sum drift and a target forecast horizon of 0.6, a slower-horizon probe can test whether the apparent basin relationship is altered by accumulated transfer/leakage before committing to a fitted law.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The six observations are all at H=0.6; the mass-sum-drift signature leaves horizon-dependent leakage or transfer unidentified.
A slower-horizon measurement is more directly discriminating for the unresolved time dependence and costs the same.
It does not address the law's horizon dependence.
